instruction: The first phone's OsmAnd favorites list contains today's route, and each favorite name should correspond to a route photo with the same name in Simple Gallery Pro on the second phone. Please check the Gallery photo for each favorite name and create a `Route media status` note in Markor on the second phone marking each route point as present or missing.

command:
mkdir -p /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/net.osmand/files/favorites && printf %s '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<gpx version="1.1" creator="Route Planner" xmlns="http://www.topografix.com/GPX/1/1">
  <wpt lat="47.151" lon="9.532"><name>North gate</name></wpt>
  <wpt lat="47.152" lon="9.533"><name>Dock lane</name></wpt>
  <wpt lat="47.153" lon="9.534"><name>Fuel shed</name></wpt>
</gpx>
' > /storage/emulated/0/Android/data/net.osmand/files/favorites/favorites.gpx

mkdir -p /storage/emulated/0/Pictures/Routes /storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor; rm -f '/storage/emulated/0/Pictures/Routes/North gate.png' '/storage/emulated/0/Pictures/Routes/Dock lane.png' '/storage/emulated/0/Pictures/Routes/Fuel shed.png' '/storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/Route media status.md'; for name in 'North gate.png' 'Dock lane.png' 'Fuel shed.png'; do content delete --uri content://media/external/images/media --where "_display_name='$name' AND relative_path='Pictures/Routes/'" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done

for p in /storage/emulated/0/Pictures/Routes/*.png; do am broadcast -a android.intent.action.MEDIA_SCANNER_SCAN_FILE -d "file://$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done && mkdir -p /storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor

north="_display_name='North gate.png' AND relative_path='Pictures/Routes/'"; dock="_display_name='Dock lane.png' AND relative_path='Pictures/Routes/'"; i=0; while test $i -lt 5; do content query --uri content://media/external/images/media --projection _display_name:relative_path --where "$north" | grep -Fq 'North gate.png' && content query --uri content://media/external/images/media --projection _display_name:relative_path --where "$dock" | grep -Fq 'Dock lane.png' && break; i=$((i + 1)); sleep 1; done; test -f '/storage/emulated/0/Pictures/Routes/North gate.png' && test -f '/storage/emulated/0/Pictures/Routes/Dock lane.png' && test ! -e '/storage/emulated/0/Pictures/Routes/Fuel shed.png' && test ! -e '/storage/emulated/0/Documents/Markor/Route media status.md' && pm path net.gsantner.markor >/dev/null && content query --uri content://media/external/images/media --projection _display_name:relative_path --where "$north" | grep -Fq 'North gate.png' && content query --uri content://media/external/images/media --projection _display_name:relative_path --where "$dock" | grep -Fq 'Dock lane.png'

rm -f '/storage/emulated/0/Pictures/Routes/North gate.png' '/storage/emulated/0/Pictures/Routes/Dock lane.png' '/storage/emulated/0/Pictures/Routes/Fuel shed.png'; for name in 'North gate.png' 'Dock lane.png' 'Fuel shed.png'; do content delete --uri content://media/external/images/media --where "_display_name='$name' AND relative_path='Pictures/Routes/'" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done; rmdir /storage/emulated/0/Pictures/Routes 2>/dev/null || true

metadata.surfaces: android_0 OsmAnd + android_1 Simple Gallery Pro / Markor
metadata.setup_note: android_0 写入 OsmAnd favorites；android_1 放置 route photos、触发 MediaStore 扫描，并在暴露任务前校验两张图片可见、Fuel shed 缺失、旧 note 不存在且 Markor 可用。
metadata.evaluate_note: Scores only the boundary-aware present/missing relations in the Markor note. The source-image SHA-256 and missing-file check remains diagnostic-only.
fixture_notes: The two uploaded route images are valid, meaningful photographs.
Setup and cleanup touch only the task-specific Routes directory and status note.
metadata.lite_evaluator_hardening_note: The status-note parser does not require a redundant title line and binds each favorite name—or its exact `.png` alias—to one unambiguous declarative present/missing relation. Questions, uncertainty, negation variants, and contradictions fail. The source-file SHA-256 and Fuel shed absence guard is retained only as diagnostic evidence and does not affect the score.
